title: BU Ultrafast Is Live
summary: BU Ultrafast is live on every Browser Use Cloud plan in the US, with no waitlist. Set model to bu-ultrafast.
body_markdown:
## Agents


- BU Ultrafast is now available on every Browser Use Cloud plan in the US, including free. Set` model` to` bu-ultrafast` on` POST /api/v4/runs` ; it takes no model parameters.[Learn more](https://browser-use.com/ultrafast) .
- ` bu-fast` runs the same agent with more reasoning per step.
- The BU Ultrafast waitlist is closed. No action is needed if you signed up.
